dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Bagaimana menurutmu pamerannya? Kamu tampak menikmatinya.
dialogue.en: What did you think of the exhibition? You seemed to enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Sangat. Kuratornya memilih karya-karyanya dengan sangat cermat.
dialogue.en: Very much. The curator chose the pieces very carefully.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Aku setuju. Karya mana yang paling berkesan bagimu?
dialogue.en: I agree. Which work impressed you most?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Lukisan besar di ruangan terakhir. Lukisan itu dianggap sebagai mahakarya.
dialogue.en: The large painting in the last room. It is considered a masterpiece.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Menurutmu, mengapa lukisan itu begitu terkenal?
dialogue.en: Why do you think it is so famous?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Mungkin karena lukisan itu menampilkan orang biasa dengan cara yang sangat jujur.
dialogue.en: Perhaps because it shows ordinary people in a very honest way.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Menarik. Aku mendengarkan pemandu audio, dan penjelasannya sangat berbeda.
dialogue.en: Interesting. I listened to the audio guide, and it gave a very different explanation.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Seni terbuka untuk penafsiran, dan itulah yang membuat museum begitu menarik.
dialogue.en: Art is open to interpretation, which is what makes museums exciting.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Benar. Sebagian orang bilang museum tidak seharusnya semahal itu.
dialogue.en: True. Some people say museums should not be so expensive.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Menurutku tiket masuk seharusnya murah, karena budaya milik semua orang.
dialogue.en: I think entry should be cheap, because culture belongs to everyone.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Tetapi merawat warisan budaya membutuhkan banyak biaya.
dialogue.en: But maintaining cultural heritage costs a lot of money.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Itu poin yang sah. Mungkin hari gratis setiap bulan bisa jadi kompromi.
dialogue.en: That is a valid point. Perhaps free days each month could be a compromise.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Banyak kota sudah melakukannya, dan museumnya jadi sangat ramai.
dialogue.en: Many cities already do that, and the museums become very crowded.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Keramaian itu pertanda baik, kok: itu menunjukkan bahwa orang menghargai seni.
dialogue.en: Crowds are a good sign, though: they show that people value art.

dialogue.speaker: Dewi
dialogue.text: Betul juga. Bagaimana kalau kita mengunjungi museum seni modern akhir pekan depan?
dialogue.en: Fair enough. Shall we visit the modern art museum next weekend?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Dengan senang hati. Kali ini aku akan mengunduh pemandu audionya terlebih dahulu.
dialogue.en: Gladly. This time I will download the audio guide in advance.
